primary_task: Narrow a 26-row transactions list to the platforms you care about, then apply it.

controls.label: Last 90 days (default)
controls.on_click: Panel opens with 6 options (All time, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days [selected], This month, Last month) plus an Apply button.

controls.label: Add filter
controls.on_click: Menu lists 4 fields: Platform, Type, Amount, Customer.

controls.label: Platform (added via Add filter)
controls.on_add: A Platform chip is inserted into the bar and its panel opens immediately, showing 4 checkboxes (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal, Amazon) plus Clear and Apply.

interaction_sequence.action: click checkbox option 'Shopify' (second toggle, same panel)
interaction_sequence.observed: Panel is no longer visible. The Apply button inside it is not hittable. The Shopify selection was never committed and there is no way to reach Apply without reopening the chip.

controls.note: Liveness was asserted by visibility and hittability in real Chromium, not by reading checkbox state. Checkbox state alone reports correctly here.
